name: Microgrid reactive-setpoint ramp limiter
aliases: microgrids Microgrid voltage and reactive-power controls
summary: Constrains the change rate of the assigned reactive-power request.
description: Constrains the change rate of the assigned reactive-power request. Voltage and reactive-power control coordinate the AC operating condition of the microgrid resources. A voltage target, reactive-power target and power-factor target represent different control objectives and should have explicit ownership.

In an islanded microgrid, the assigned reference source supports bus voltage while other compatible resources share reactive demand according to the selected control method. Grid-connected operation can use a different objective at the PCC. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Reactive-power target” at the input and “Rate-limited reactive request” at the output. The resource response remains equipment-dependent.
